roadmap.title: Chapter 1 — play, and save
roadmap.text: Finish the opening mission and Chapter 1, beat Cal at fishing, finish one arcade game, and do the balcony meditation at Jason's house while it is available. Make a manual save at the start of the chapter: there is no mission replay, so a chapter-start save is your only way back.

roadmap.title: Chapters 2–4 — the story
roadmap.text: Play the story through to the final mission. Character switching opens in Chapter 2, which unlocks the partner trophies and the stranger strands. Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3 — it is time-sensitive. Finish the six side-story finales (Andy, Billy, Kenton, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) whenever they appear; they stay open after the credits.

roadmap.title: Robberies and partner feats
roadmap.text: Once the robbery tools arrive in Chapters 3 and 4 — the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, then the bank-vault job near the end of Chapter 4 — take the robbery trophies and the partner feats that ride along with them, including the 4-star escape that also clears Hot Together.

roadmap.title: Open-world sweep
roadmap.text: After the credits, everything outside the story stays open: collectibles (cards, WAiNK spots, vehicles, areas), races, shooting ranges, stunts, Challenges and the money trophies. Work them in any order and let the progress counters in this tracker do the counting.

roadmap.title: 100% and the platinum
roadmap.text: The 100% checklist only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but work done earlier still counts. It needs more than the trophies do — 300 stunts instead of 250, 70 of 80 Challenges, all 8 bank vaults, 200 of 277 vehicle models — so keep grinding past each trophy pop until A Long Road lands, and Vice Got a Price! follows.

saveRules: There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus at launch: once a story mission is done you cannot select it again.
Keep one manual save at the start of every chapter, plus one untouched save from just before the final mission. The game has 15 manual save slots plus one autosave.
Do the balcony meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — it is the one trophy reported as potentially missable, and it disappears when the chapter ends.
Do Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 as soon as it appears; it carries an hourglass icon and is time-sensitive.
Never test cheats on your trophy save: cheats are expected to switch off trophies and saving.

tips.text: No mission replay: treat every chapter as one-way. Save manually at each chapter start and before the final mission, so a missed moment costs minutes, not a new playthrough.
Do the balcony meditation at Jason's house the morning after Down to Earth, while Chapter 1 is still open — the potentially missable trophy hangs on it, and the chapter does not reopen.
When Race Against Yago appears in Chapter 3, run it at once: it is the list's one time-sensitive trophy and will not wait for your endgame sweep.
Keep cheats out of your trophy save: they are expected to block saving and trophy progress for the rest of that session.
Hunt the partner trophies as a pair — the wanted-level escape and the back-to-back shop robberies only count with Lucia and Jason together.
Do not chase true 100%: the checklist A Long Road measures asks for roughly 60% of everything the game tracks, so let it name your targets.
Spend your save slots: 15 manual slots plus an autosave covers a save per chapter, one before any one-chance moment, and a Chapter 1 save you never overwrite.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the reward for everything else: it pops the moment the 54th other trophy lands, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Follow the roadmap in order — story first with a save at every chapter start, then the robbery and partner feats, then the open-world sweep — and finish with the 100% checklist, which is the longest single job at roughly 200 hours for the whole platinum. No online, difficulty or medal trophy stands in the way; it is long, not hard.
trophies.short: The platinum pops on its own when the 54th other trophy lands — there is nothing to do for it directly. Follow the roadmap in order and leave the 100% checklist for last; the whole run takes roughly 200 hours.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
Leave A Long Road (100% Completion) for last — it is the longest grind.
Earn every other trophy first — the platinum pops when the 54th lands.
